contents.paragraph:
This report is designed to help the Team Leaders to appraise each employee, his work performance and potential abilities.
It helps the Team Leaders to guide employees to develop and improve competencies.
This Appraisal Report will also provide to the Management information on each employees performance and skill development needs and in turn translate into a tool for rewards, financial or otherwise.
guideline_point_list: Please complete the forms on the basis of the work that the employee has been doing during the period under review.
70% weightage would be given for technical assessment and 30 % weightage for behavioural assessment.
Assessment should be indicated by relevant points in the appropriate column.
Base your assessment on direct knowledge and employee’s performance on the job.
Have the rating reflect typical NORMAL performance. Avoid being influenced by recent instance of success or failure which is not typical.
Name and designation of the Reporting, Reviewing and countersigning authorities must be written clearly to avoid difficulties for future reference.
During appraisal, the rating and the overall rating should not be revealed to the employee.
Mention atleast 2 technical training & 2 Non technical training.
Please ensure that all the columns are filled and your final comments are also recorded.

qustions.qustion: What are your major achievements in the last one year?
What are the technical skills that you have learnt over the last year?
What are your goals for the next one year?
What are your developmental areas for the next assessment year?
What are your views/suggestions regarding your supervisors & the organization?

personal_appraisal.points_for_evaluation:
Please use the following points for evaluation.

Outstanding - 5    Very Good - 4    Good - 3    Average - 2    Below Average - 1

technical_attributes.head: Work Estimate Accuracy Rate
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Work estimate for programming tasks that are accurate within of acutals)

technical_attributes.head: SLA to Release Schedule
technical_attributes.sub_name: (No release to go beyond planned date )

technical_attributes.head: Errors Per Lines of Code
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Reduce of errors per lines of code)

technical_attributes.head: Bug Rates
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Achive bug-free code for delivery to production)

technical_attributes.head: Bugs Reported by End Users
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Bugs reported by end users for every release)

technical_attributes.head: Software Application Performance Rating Provided by Client
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Satisfaction score product management to development team)

technical_attributes.head: Discipline / Conduct
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Willingness and attitude to carry out instructions of superiors and obey company rules)

technical_attributes.head: Ability to work in a team
technical_attributes.sub_name: ( Co-operates with others; acts to foster team spirit and achievement of team goals)

technical_attributes.head: Attendance & punctuality
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Regularity in attendance and punctual in time and availability at work spot.)

technical_attributes.head: Innovation/Contribution for improvements
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Ability to contribute to improvements in work /to express suggestion; solve work related problems)

technical_attributes.head: Communication Skills
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Ability to convey ideas, issues etc effectively and in a timely manner)

technical_attributes.head: Supervision
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Ability to complete work without close supervision)

technical_attributes.head: Attitude
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Does appraisee have a positive attitude towards work and life in general)

technical_attributes.head: Learning & Self Development
technical_attributes.sub_name: (Displays a spirit of learning new skills & technologies)
